authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Generic cEDH packages (Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, rituals, Thassa's Oracle) were deliberately not added (blueprint L48).
Don't treat Garza as an incidental body in a value shell.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Repeated removal makes a seven-mana commander uncastable.
One-threat Voltron loses to edicts and chump-blocking.
Jeska dies if Garza hasn't been cast from the command zone.

value.interaction: Cheap removal and counters (Mana Drain, Counterspell, Terminate, Deadly Rollick, Pongify, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift).
value.mana: 38 lands plus Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Ancient Tomb, Command Beacon.
value.protection: Equipment protection, boots, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Garza is the only real threat: her damage triggers the growth, her hits draw, and every closer is aimed at her.
accepted_role.honest_note: Seven mana with a rising commander tax, and every plan runs through one creature: removal or a chump-proof blocker stalls the deck (source: blueprint L44). Her draw clause is a 'may' that only works on player hits.

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?
